# rWCVPdata

rWCVPdata is a data package that redistributes snapshots of the World
Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP) database so it is easier to load
into R.

## Installation

rWCVPdata is not hosted on CRAN, but you can install it using:

``` r
install.packages("rWCVPdata", repos=c("https://matildabrown.github.io/drat", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Or you can add our data repository to your repo list first:

``` r
r <- getOption("repos")
r["matildabrown"] <- "https://matildabrown.github.io/drat"
options(repos=r)

install.packages("rWCVPdata")
```

You can install the latest development version of rWCVPdata from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("matildabrown/rWCVPdata")
```

## Citation

If you use rWCVPdata, please cite the snapshot of the database you used
and the paper describing WCVP.

You can find out how to cite these by running:

``` r
citation("rWCVPdata")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`coast`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/coast.md)
  : Aggregated WGSRPD3 polygons, for mapping
- [`coast_pacific`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/coast_pacific.md)
  : Aggregated WGSRPD3 polygons centered on 180 longitude, for mapping
- [`wcvp_check_version()`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wcvp_check_version.md)
  : Check if the packaged version of WCVP is up to date.
- [`wcvp_distributions`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wcvp_distributions.md)
  : The World Checklist of Vascular Plants: distributions
- [`wcvp_names`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wcvp_names.md)
  : The World Checklist of Vascular Plants: names
- [`wcvp_version()`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wcvp_version.md)
  : Functions to help check the WCVP data is okay and up to date. View
  the version of WCVP available.
- [`wgsrpd3`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wgsrpd3.md)
  : Biodiversity Information Standards (TDWG) World Geographical Scheme
  for Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD)
- [`wgsrpd3_pacific`](https://matildabrown.github.io/rWCVPdata/reference/wgsrpd3_pacific.md)
  : Biodiversity Information Standards (TDWG) World Geographical Scheme
  for Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD), centered on 180 longitude
